description: Look up a swap made with create_swap by its swap_id and explain where it is: PENDING (no deposit seen yet), PROCESSING, SUCCESS, FAILED, REFUNDED, INCOMPLETE_DEPOSIT (less than required arrived) or EXPIRED (address closed, never send to it). swap_id is the protocol-prefixed id create_swap returned, such as near:<deposit address> or chainflip:<block>-<network>-<channel>; pass it unchanged, prefix included. Returns amounts in normal units and the deposit, payout and refund transaction links. A malformed id is rejected before any request, an unknown one returns "No swap with that id", and a router outage returns an error to retry later. Use it when the user asks whether their swap arrived. Read-only and safe to repeat; poll every 30 seconds or more, not in a tight loop.

swap_id.description: swap_id exactly as returned by create_swap, e.g. "near:0xAbc..." or "chainflip:123-Btc-45".

name: get_swap_status

expires_at.description: When the deposit address stops accepting funds.

reason.description: Failure or refund reason from the route, if any.

title: Check swap status
